title: At the Hollow King's throne I chose 'leave the barrow open to the sky' and the game logged 'Quest done: The Barrow Doors.' Several turns later, back at Last Light Square, the reeve still offered 'promise to seal the barrow' as a live dialogue option. Taking it gave a full reward (the Watch +1, a 'watch shield' item, Tamsin approves/Osk disapproves) and the line 'I'm holding you to it: when he rests, the doors shut' — directly contradicting the already-finalized, opposite outcome I'd chosen at the throne minutes earlier.
where: Last Light Square / talk to reeve, after already resolving 'The Barrow Doors' at Throne of the Barrow
